headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 16, 2026**
article:
The New York Mets secured a 4-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Francisco Alvarez leading the offense. Alvarez hit two home runs and drove in two runs in just three at-bats. The Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays 10-0, handing them a decisive defeat. Griffin Jax led the Red Sox pitching staff, while Anthony Seigler and Caleb Durbin were among the Rays' top performers at the plate. The Cleveland Guardians secured a 0-0 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, marking a close contest in the matchup.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, affecting their team's roster. Brent Rooker of the Athletics has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a bone bruise in his left knee. Brice Matthews of the Houston Astros has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 14, 2026, with a left knee sprain. Brad Keller of the Philadelphia Phillies has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 13, 2026, with a right elbow UCL tear. Other players, including Tommy Troy of the Arizona Diamondbacks, Rob Zastryzny of the Milwaukee Brewers, Drew Millas of the Washington Nationals, Nick Mears of the Kansas City Royals, and Keegan Akin of the Baltimore Orioles, have also been affected by injuries.

The Washington Nationals made a trade on July 16, 2026, sending CF Robert Hassell III to the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for cash. The Houston Astros traded RHP Lance McCullers Jr., LHP Colton Gordon, and cash to the Milwaukee Brewers for OF Jadyn Fielder. The Detroit Tigers traded OF Jahmai Jones to the Boston Red Sox for a player to be named later.
